d: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

This role will be focused on coordination of internal and external audit engagements for Binance ADGM Compliance, ensuring recommendations and actions provided by regulators and auditors are tracked to resolution, performing validation/assurance on closures to ensure expectations are met. You will work closely with Compliance Leaders, Audit, Legal, Product, and Business Lines across ADGM and the Central Compliance teams to maintain a comprehensive, standardized audit and regulatory issue management framework, including engagements, metrics, plans, processes, and remediations.
q: 10+ years compliance, audit and/or regulatory exam management experience, including performance of closure validation/assurance
Knowledge and understanding of financial services regulations, compliance policies, standards, and procedures.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, global organization while maintaining close contact with relevant teams across multiple locations
Excellent problem solving, communication and written skills with the ability to articulate complex concepts into a format digestible by a diverse audience
Strong project management skills with the ability to create external facing material in conjunction with internal stakeholders
Proactive and diligent teamwork, interpersonal and conflict resolution skills.
Highly organized and capable of dealing with complex projects.
Experience gained from crypto/fintech and ADGM regulatory environment is preferred
Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

r: Support the ADGM Compliance team on closure of regulatory exams and external audits using subject matter expertise in financial crime related frameworks and audit processes
Foster strong relationships with key Central Compliance functions to ensure effective engagement and delivery of items related to outsourced compliance activities
Follow a standardized exam and audit issue management framework, ensuring transparency on progress of issue/action remedial activity is provided to all stakeholders
Track resolution of regulatory exam and audits providing support where required to ensure the ADGM Binance entities are presented in a compliant manner
Perform closure validation on actions proposed as closed by the relevant teams to ensure closure satisfies the initial gap identified
Assist with special projects as needed, with the ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.
